name: Project Lightning Bug
description: An Izzet project turned into a beacon to call other planeswalkers.

description_citations.text: "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ral explains that Vraska left Ravnica for no destination, as if into a void, and has not been seen since.
timeline.quote: She didn't planeswalk to a plane. Only from one.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Spatial rifts immune to electrical magic begin appearing across Ravnica, possibly a side effect of the project.
timeline.quote: several unexplained spatial rifts began appearing all over Ravnica

citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug", section "Rifts". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Niv-Mizzet reveals the threat of Bolas and has Ral Zarek turn Project Lightning Bug into a beacon.
timeline.quote: he has Ral Zarek turn Project Lightning Bug into a beacon to call other planeswalkers to help fight Bolas

citation.text: "Ravnica", section "Outside influence". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: An Izzet project to track Jace's disappearances by detecting planeswalks as lightning, which Ral secretly sabotages.

citation.text: "Project Lightning Bug" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 May 2015.

pages_say.description: An Izzet experiment to detect planeswalks, officially shut down but secretly still running.

citation.text: "In This Very Arena" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Oct 2016.

pages_say.description: Izzet project on Ravnica, run by Ral Zarek, that detects planeswalkers; later turned into a beacon calling planeswalkers against Bolas.
